Link i to node i (5 nodes around it) starts at 300 + 280 i ms and draws from the hub edge over 320 ms easeOutCubic with a small accent head dot; the node (r 13, card fill, letter label) then pops 0 -> 1 over 300 ms back.out while a ring 13 -> 25 px fades over 600 ms easeOutCubic. Exit from 3.4 s: nodes and links retract in reverse order, 50 ms apart, 300 ms ease-in cubic. Params: nodes (5) · stagger (0.28 s) · draw: vẽ đường (0.32 s).
